extracted.intended_audience: public information officers, joint information center staff, and emergency/public affairs practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled toolkit index of doctrine, guides, templates, forms, qualification standards, job aids, training, and resources to support Joint Information System (JIS) operations and PIO responsibilities during incidents. The page points PIOs toward authoritative documents for press releases, risk communication, social media, and incident information management.

rubrics_metrics.description: Listed under Doctrine as a source of external affairs/public information policy and procedures for the U.S. Coast Guard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toolkit pointer: consult this manual for Coast Guard doctrine, public affairs standards, and procedures applicable to PIO operations and communications products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall JIS Toolkit purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The Joint Information System (JIS) Toolkit provides a compilation of guidance, resources, and templates from various leading JIS organizations to help organizations identify key resources that address their needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the toolkit as an index to authoritative doctrine, guides, templates, forms, and training when developing press releases and other JIS products; select resources relevant to jurisdiction, hazard, and agency.
